units.text: The 2025 Nobel science prizes had varying laureate counts: Physics had 3, Chemistry had 5, Physiology or Medicine had 3, Economic Sciences had 3; not all prizes had exactly three laureates.

judgement.reason: The passages support Physics having 3 and Physiology or Medicine having 3 laureates, but they list only 3 Chemistry laureates (contradicting the claimed 5) and provide no information on Economic Sciences laureate count; the total of 14 individuals does not by itself confirm the per-prize counts.

units.text: Span 27 confirms fourteen total laureates across categories with unequal distribution: three each in physiology or medicine, physics, chemistry and economics, and one each in literature and peace.
